import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.fea as fea
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# Create core system and FEA subsystem
my_system = chrono.ChSystem()
fea_system = fea.ChSystemFEM()
my_system.Add(fea_system)

# Simulation parameters
num_elements = 10
length = 5.0  # Beam length in meters
delta_L = length / num_elements

# Material properties
E = 2e11       # Young's modulus (Pa)
nu = 0.3       # Poisson's ratio
rho = 8000     # Density (kg/m³)

# Cross-section dimensions (rectangular)
width = 0.1    # y-direction
height = 0.05  # z-direction
area = width * height

# Moment of inertia calculations
Iy = (width * (height ** 3)) / 12.0
Iz = (height * (width ** 3)) / 12.0

# Create nodes along the beam
nodes = []
for i in range(num_elements + 1):
    x = i * delta_L
    node = fea.ChNodeFEAxyzD()
    node.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(x, 0, 0))
    fea_system.AddNode(node)
    nodes.append(node)

# Create beam elements between nodes
elements = []
for i in range(num_elements):
    element = fea.ChElementBeamANCF()
    element.SetNodes(nodes[i], nodes[i+1])
    
    # Set material and cross-section properties
    element.Set_E(E)
    element.Set_G(E / (2 * (1 + nu)))
    element.Set_density(rho)
    element.Set_Area(area)
    element.Set_Iy(Iy)
    element.Set_Iz(Iz)
    
    fea_system.AddElement(element)
    elements.append(element)

# Apply boundary condition (fixed at first node)
nodes[0].SetFixed(True)

# Add visualization assets to each element
for element in elements:
    vis = fea.ChVisualizationFEAmesh()
    vis.SetFEMcolor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.8))
    element.AddAsset(vis)

# Setup Irrlicht visualization
app = irr.ChIrrApp(my_system, 'Beam FEA Simulation', irr.CHIRRRESIZABLE)
app.SetCameraPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(5, 5, 5))
app.SetCameraLookAt(chrono.ChVectorD(2.5, 0, 0))
app.AssetBind()
app.AssetUpdate()
app.AddAllTypicalLights()

# Configure integrator (HHT implicit solver)
my_system.SetTimestepper(chrono.ChTimestepperHHT(my_system))
my_system.GetTimestepper().SetAlpha(-0.2)
my_system.GetTimestepper().SetMaxiters(50)
my_system.GetTimestepper().SetAbsTolerances(1e-6)
my_system.GetTimestepper().SetRelTolerances(1e-6)
my_system.GetTimestepper().SetDt(0.01)  # Time step

# Enable gravity
my_system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# Run simulation loop
app.Run()
